sources.note: The official Formosa tourism report identifies Kika's Pastelería as the team associated with participant Luana Arias among the Formosa-city alfajoreros at the 2026 Regional Alfajor Festival and names its mamón-and-cheese alfajor.

The July 2026 report identifies Kika's Pastelería as Luana Arias's active pastry business in Formosa city, describes the elaboration of its mamón-and-cheese alfajor and reports two local stores and daily production growth.
